dedupe_keys.name: ddt de l isere water datasets

description: DDT de l'Isère: water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DDT de l'Isère. Coverage: DDT de l'Isère. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Zones de sauvegarde des ressources stratégiques pour l’alimentation en; AEP : Zone de protection d'une aire d'alimentation de captages (AAC) d; Stations d'épuration localisées ponctuellement - Isère; Points d'introduction dans le milieu naturel des eaux épurées issues d. Formats seen: ZIP, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
